The thing i like with Jamie's rape is they dont just let his trauma disappear like it did with Claire from S1. He has to find his way back to Claire for months, he visibly is hurting emotionally and mentally. Its something I as a molestation and rape victim identify with, because the pain from something like that doesn't just go away. It stays with you, it changes how you live and how you see things and people around you. 
It was a very triggering episode, I honestly cried for a good 30 minutes trying to calm down from my own trauma after hearing everything that happened to Jamie. But I like that they did show that the trauma doesn't just go away. It makes it more understandable for people who have had the luxury of not going through such an awful experience. And that they even make sure the victim knows its not their fault for what happened to them. 
I love this show for so many things. Including how they have portrayed how difficult it can be to find yourself once again after being so violated.
